Jack Heart, 2026-11-13, on STU-3 (Split the launcher into a machines layer and one runtime per kind of work): "Merge this into 58. 58 is probably more up to date". STU-3 is completed as merged here; this Task is the surviving one.

What STU-3 leaves, for this design to read before deciding anything about the machine model:

- An unmerged branch `lf/9dfc5000fc604354999a73d7d784a027/split-the-launcher-into-a`, worktree `/Users/jack/src/etude.machines-and-runtimes`, last commit 2ccdd74 on 2026-10-14: about 13,600 inserted lines across 110 files against its merge base. It was written before the repository split, against `client/src/etude/`, stacked on the experiment-API PRs of that time. It will not apply to main at v0.3.1 as it stands. The branch and worktree are kept, not deleted.
- What it implements: `etude.machines` owning capacity (Runtime, Pool, MachineTemplate, Machine, Rental, Claim, Request, Start; admission, exclusive claims, provider facts, RunPod acquisition, billing and deletion) with `etude.launch` keeping training execution; a `Capacity` Python interface and `etude rent / machine wait / machine show / machine release / terminate` with `--json` and `--request` idempotency; folder tests that machine imports cannot reach training or tracking.
- Directions recorded there with Jack Heart, 2026-10-13: separate runtimes (training, agents) with their own pools and limits and no intentional sharing of one machine between runtimes; one compute CLI for training and agent capacity. Exclusive pool ownership was "an implemented reversible assumption, not an additional accepted decision".
- Where today differs: on 2026-11-13 he said of agent capacity "for right now ive decided to keep the compute launching interfaces different, and its not clear that we will need agentcompute launching". And this Task wants runs to share a machine and to tell a run's load from the machine's total, which STU-3's exclusive claims did not model.
- Full notes: `scratch/split-the-launcher-into-a.md` in that worktree; `docs/design/decisions.md` 156-165 in etude-studio.

Not decided here: whether any of the branch is ported or it serves only as reference.
